title: THREE DOTS
lesson: Let them finish before you panic
caption: Overthinking a text? THE RULE BOOK Ep 18: I texted Solo 'are you S?' and Clyde crashed out over three dots. The full text said 'S is for sorry.' Then Ruva went quiet. Drop a rule the book should have. What does Ruva know? A) Dad's old partner B) Dad's old enemy. A or B? Pause at 0:05 👀 #overthinking #liferules #stickman
